architecture_invariants: Each raw source retains independent identity and batch lineage until separate quality/use admission authorizes a downstream combination.
Raw equalisation storage and treated-water quarantine storage are separate hydraulic inventories.
Every inlet, outlet, backwash, purge, reject, overflow and drain route has a named destination and measured or uncertainty-bounded balance.
Treatment modules cannot self-authorize output quality or release.
Critical quality or metrology uncertainty results in hold/isolate/divert to approved residual route; protected alternate supply remains physically separate.
Cloud, AI and external connectivity are not required for safe local operation.
No potable/nonpotable interconnection is permitted in the initial prototype.
All alternative trains are compared on identical feed, intended use, demand, temperature, storage age, fault script, test duration and evidence class.

modules.name: Source inlet screen and lint capture
modules.purpose: Remove coarse lint/hair/large debris from declared bathroom feed; not a pathogen or dissolved-contaminant barrier.
design_evidence_required: captured solids mass and disposal route
modules.safe_state: isolate feed or divert; do not treat bypassed screen as admitted pre-treatment

modules.name: Raw equalisation and diversion
modules.purpose: Buffer variable inflow and support controlled batch admission; does not provide a validated disinfection or treatment barrier.
design_evidence_required: tank geometry and calibrated level-volume relation
modules.safe_state: stop/divert source inflow to approved route; preserve raw/treated separation

modules.name: Primary separation and sedimentation
modules.purpose: Provide selected solids separation ahead of the candidate process; efficacy and required residence are not assumed.
design_evidence_required: solids capture under defined feed profile
modules.safe_state: isolate downstream; divert feed; remove residual under approved procedure

modules.name: Biological treatment module slot
modules.purpose: Optional biological process slot for a specifically characterized feed and intended-use target.
modules.safe_state: hold/quarantine product; bypass only to approved waste route, never direct use

modules.name: Ultrafiltration module slot
modules.purpose: Optional membrane polishing/barrier module; membrane integrity and operating limits must be independently tested.
modules.safe_state: close product outlet, isolate module and divert/hold feed

modules.name: Ozone oxidation module slot
modules.purpose: Optional oxidation module; oxidant generation, off-gas, residuals, by-products and occupational safety require separate hazard review.
design_evidence_required: ozone generator identity and dose method
modules.safe_state: de-energize oxidant generation, isolate process and divert; no product release

modules.name: Granular activated carbon adsorption module slot
modules.purpose: Optional adsorption/polishing slot; GAC identity, breakthrough and changeout evidence are mandatory.
modules.safe_state: isolate adsorber; hold/divert product; replace media and recommission

modules.name: Slow sand or granular media filtration module slot
modules.purpose: Optional filtration/polishing stage; maturation, media identity, hydraulic rate and cleaning/reset state must be demonstrated.
modules.safe_state: isolate and divert until performance re-established

modules.name: Ultraviolet disinfection barrier slot
modules.purpose: Optional disinfection barrier only where the use-specific risk/quality plan requires and validated UV dose can be demonstrated.
design_evidence_required: validated reactor configuration and dose envelope
challenge organism method and independent test
modules.safe_state: close product/quarantine outlet; divert or hold; do not treat lamp energization as dose proof

modules.name: Nature-based / constructed wetland process slot
modules.purpose: Optional site-specific passive or hybrid biological stage; requires land, hydraulic, pretreatment and seasonal process qualification.
modules.safe_state: stop release and divert/hold; maintenance and requalification before restart

modules.name: Post-treatment polishing module slot
modules.purpose: Optional final solids/adsorption/filtration barrier selected from the exact intended-use risk assessment.
modules.safe_state: hold/divert product until renewed evidence and replacement

modules.name: Treated product quarantine tank
modules.purpose: Physically segregated hold tank preventing unadmitted product from reaching a use outlet.
modules.safe_state: normally closed release; quarantine or drain to approved route

modules.name: Independent release interlock interface
modules.purpose: Consume independently admitted quality and process state; no AI or cloud authority.
modules.safe_state: close release; enter hold/divert state; mains fallback remains separate

modules.name: Measurement and sample interface
modules.purpose: Consumes Mycelix measurement/sample and calibration contracts; not a new sensor passport or lab system.
modules.safe_state: mark critical evidence unadmitted; trigger process release interlock

process_options.notes: Useful only as a collection/service baseline; no treatment or reuse quality claim.
Compact physical barrier candidate; requires actual membrane integrity, UVT/dose, fouling and cleaning tests.
Oxidation/adsorption candidate; requires off-gas, oxidant residual, by-product, GAC breakthrough and regrowth testing.
Site/land-specific candidate; must count land, seasonal variability, clogging and maintenance, not just kWh.

required_gates: Unoccupied physical test cell approved and detailed P&ID frozen by owner #5335.
Use-specific quality plan admitted by Mycelix #6100 for every claimed service output.
WaterLoop service continuity and cost outputs use existing T0 evaluators; no parallel evaluator.
Qualified South African plumbing/electrical/process review and applicable approvals before fabrication/installation.
nonclaims: No module or train is selected, sized, built, installed or qualified by this concept inventory.
No potable water output or SANS 241 compliance is claimed.
No treated wastewater reuse permission or health outcome is inferred.
No physical energy, throughput, cost, maintenance or service performance is established.
No autonomous treatment or release authority is granted to AI/cloud systems.
